description: Node removes type annotations (replacing them with whitespace) and runs the remaining JavaScript. No type checking, no `tsconfig` reading.
TypeScript that disappears without generating code: annotations, interfaces, `import type`, `satisfies`. Enums, runtime namespaces and parameter properties are not erasable.
TypeScript 5.8+ compiler option that reports non-erasable constructs, so code stays runnable with Node's type stripping.
esbuild-based runner and watcher that executes any TypeScript, including enums and `tsconfig` paths. Does not type-check.
Runs the TypeScript compiler only to type-check. The CI step that catches type errors no runner reports.
Makes TypeScript follow Node's real ESM/CommonJS rules (extensions, `type` field, `.mts`/`.cts`), so invalid imports fail in the editor instead of at runtime.
